production.note: US model years 2012 to 2016. First: the spec sheet is headed "2012 Porsche 911 Technical Specifications" with the column "911 Carrera (991)". Last: kbb-2016-911 lists a 2016 Carrera with a "6-Cyl, 3.4 Liter" engine and "350 horsepower @ 7,400 rpm"; for 2017 the Carrera became the twin-turbo 991.2 (pcna-2017-911-carrera-specs: "Boxer, twin-turbo", "3.0 l", "370 hp @ 6500").

body.note: The 2013 sheet gives "Curb weight w/ manual (Cabriolet)" figures, so the Cabriolet is the open version of the same variant. The 2012 sheet covers only the "Two-plus-two sport coupe".

displacementL.note: 3,436 cc. Quote: "3,436 cm3" (911 Carrera; Carrera S "3,800 cm3"). The 2012 sheet says "3.4 liters".

aspiration.note: Inferred: the sheet describes a water-cooled flat six with no turbocharger or supercharger; the twin-turbo engine arrived with the 2017 car.

fuel.note: Inferred from the spec sheet's engine description; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: "7-speed manual" and "7-speed, double-clutch (PDK)". DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum Horsepower 350 hp @ 7400 rpm 400 hp @ 7400 rpm" (911 Carrera (991) | 911 Carrera S (991)). Same on the 2013 sheet and still 350 hp for 2016 per kbb-2016-911.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 7-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight w/ manual 3,042 lbs. 3,075 lbs." (911 Carrera (991) | 911 Carrera S (991)). PDK coupe 3,086 lb. The 2013 sheet repeats it with the Cabriolet: "Curb weight w/ manual (Cabriolet) 3,042 lbs. (3,197 lbs.)".
